ex: She is alleged to have been at the centre of an international drug ring.
ex: Education should be relevant to the child's needs.
ex: The statistics show that, in general, women live longer than men.
ex: The brochure will be ready for publication in September.
ex: My mother is an expert at dress-making (= she does it very well).
ex: He's the president's chief political strategist.
ex: The country's leadership is in crisis.
ex: The corporate giants try to drive down wages in order to make superprofits
ex: The union safeguards the interests of all its members.
ex: She was confronted by a man wielding a knife.
ex: Relax, you're amongst friends.
ex: The president’s decisions stirred up a lot controversy.
ex: I also know a child at the Institution for the Deaf in Mississippi.

items.vn: (noun). Ủy ban Liên chính phủ về Biến đổi Khí hậu
items.example: ex: The IPCC was created to provide policymakers with regular scientific assessments on climate change

items.vn: (noun). Đơn vị nghiên cứu khí hậu
items.example: ex: The aim of the Climatic Research Unit (CRU) is to improve scientific understanding of the climate system
ex: The operation involves putting a small tube into your heart.

ex: Everything I do makes me better at each subsequent thing.
subsequently
ex: Who will be leading the inquiry into the accident?
ex: She closed the journal and began her preparation.
ex: We hunkered down near the campfire.

items.vn: (noun). Tai hoạ, điều gây xúc động mạnh, cú choáng người
items.example: ex: Losing his job was a severe blow to his confidence.

items.vn: (verb). Thua lỗ mạnh; Lao xuống nhanh
items.example: ex: House prices have plummeted in recent months.
ex: The aeronautics industry is booming
ex: You can take the shuttle across town.
ex: He was the chief ruler of that great city.
ex: She is now a senior executive
ex: The Court of Appeal reversed the earlier judgment.
ex: We're facing a moral/ethical dilemma
ex: The invaders quickly subjected the local tribes.
ex: Her plans to make him jealous backfired on her
ex: The whole play can be interpreted as a lament for lost youth.
ex: It was Betsy who summed up our collective thoughts.
ex: The writing on the tombstone was barely visible.
ex: The experiments were conducted by scientists in New York.
ex: It's a programme designed to appeal mainly to 16 to 25-year-olds.
ex: No one doubted that the president was a man of the highest integrity.
ex: I accepted his resignation with great reluctance.
ex: Not for one moment did he doubt the validity of those ideas.
ex: The old-fashioned type of plastic lacked transparency.
ex: Will the candidates stand up under all that scrutiny?

sections.title: Passage 1: The Rufous Hare-Wallaby
sections.html:
Distant

(adjective). xa

ex: It's a distant country

desert

(noun). Sa mạc

ex: They were lost in the desert for nine days.

semi

(adjective). một nửa

ex: The winners of the semi finals will move to the final

region

(noun). vùng miền

ex: The bird returns to this region every year

arid

(adjective). khô hạn

ex: The desert is so arid that nothing can grow there.

landscape

(noun). quang cảnh

ex: He looked over his shoulder again at the dark landscape behind him

devastate

(verb). tàn phá

ex: I was so devastated I was crying constantly.

colony

(noun). Thuộc địa

ex: Australia and New Zealand are former British colonies.

Wildlife

(noun). Động vật hoang dã

ex: The use of pesticides is killing off birds, fish and wildlife.

Commission

(noun). ủy ban

ex: The government has set up/established a commission to investigate the problem

Northern

(adjective). thuộc về phương Bắc

ex: Tom lives in the northern part of the state.

Territory

(noun). Lãnh thổ

ex: He was shot down in enemy territory.

monitor

(verb). kiểm soát

ex: The new findings suggest that women ought to monitor their cholesterol levels.

wildfire

(noun). cháy rừng

ex: Wildfires destroyed thousands of acres across Oregon.

occupy

(verb). Chiếm vị trí

ex: The rest of the time was occupied with writing a report.

wild

(noun). hoang dã

ex: In Kenya we saw elephants and lions in the wild.

declare

(verb). Tuyên bố

ex: "I won't do it!" he declared.

pronounce

(verb). tuyên bố

ex: The dessert was tried and pronounced delicious.

extinct

(adjective). tuyệt chủng

ex: There is concern that the giant panda will soon become extinct.\

breed

(verb). Gây giống

ex: Terriers are bred for their fighting instincts.

pouch

(noun). túi nhỏ

ex: All our electric shavers are supplied with a free travel pouch.

source

(noun). nguồn

ex: So far, she seemed to be his best source of information, anyway.

Traditionally

(adverb). Theo truyền thống

ex: Quaker meetings are traditionally held in silence.

medicinal

(adjective). Mang đặc tính chữa trị

ex: I keep a bottle of brandy purely for medicinal purposes.

lasting

(adjective). bền vững, lâu dài,...

ex: Did any of your teachers make a lasting impression on you?

contribution

(noun). sự đóng góp

ex: All contributions (= presents of money), no matter how small, will be much appreciated.

reintroduction

(noun). tái giới thiệu

ex: The reintroduction of Islam was of no benefit to the Tarim region.

programme

(noun). Danh mục chương trình

ex: It's my favourite TV programme - I never miss an episode.

significant

(adjective). Đáng lưu ý, quan trọng

ex: Do you think it's significant that he hasn't replied to my letter yet?

enduring

(adjective). lâu dài

ex: The motions of most lizards are executed with great but not enduring rapidity.

project

(noun). dự án

ex: We hugged each other when our exhausting project was completed

captive

(adjective). bị cầm tù

ex: the farm was used to hold prisoners of war captive

defence

(noun). phòng thủ

ex: The towers were once an important part of the city's defences.

sufficient

(adjective). Đủ

ex: This recipe should be sufficient for five people.

Paddock

(noun). bãi nuôi gia súc

ex: The horse paddock was empty.

enclosure

(noun). chỗ bị bao vây

ex: Within the wall of enclosure are two courts.

attempt

(noun). lần thử, nỗ lực

ex: He made no attempt to be sociable.

reintroduce

(verb). sử dụng lại

ex: Wolves were reintroduced into Yellowstone Park in 1995.

unfenced

(adjective). không có hàng rào

ex: There is an unfenced pond at the property so please ensure children are supervised.

eventually

(adverb). Cuối cùng

ex: It might take him ages but he'll do it eventually.

release

(verb). Giải toả

ex: He released the handbrake and the car jumped forwards.

unprotected

(adjective). không được bảo vệ

ex: Water and other liquids can stain unprotected wood surfaces.

abandon

(verb). Bỏ mặc

ex: We had to abandon the car.

transfer

(verb). chuyển

ex: He has been transferred to a psychiatric hospital.

Woodland

(noun). Rừng cây

ex: Some very rare and special plants grow in these woodlands.

Western

(adjective). miền Tây

ex: He was dressed in his usual indigo jeans and western shirt

initial

(adjective). ban đầu

ex: My initial surprise was soon replaced by delight.

recovery

(noun). sự hồi phục

ex: At last the economy is showing signs of recovery.

Hare

(noun). thỏ rừng

ex: The hare is increasing rapidly, as well as the fox.

Wallaby

(noun). Chuột túi wallaby

ex: The bloated speckled turquoise wallaby slowly sniffed at the delicious scotch egg.

Aboriginal

(adjective). thuộc về thổ dân

ex: What does it mean to be an Native American or indigenous aboriginal today?

northwest

(adjective). Tây Bắc

ex: We live in the northwest of the city.

extensive

(adjective). Bao quát, rộng rãi

ex: The hospital was much more extensive than I expected

survey

(noun). sự khảo sát, nghiên cứu

ex: the author provides a survey of the relevant literature

throughout

(adverb). trong suôt khoảng thời gian

ex: He yawned throughout the performance.

historical

(adjective). Mang tính lịch sử

ex: She specializes in historical novels set in 18th-century England.

trace

(verb). Lần theo

ex: No one has yet been able to trace the source of the rumour.

examination

(noun). việc thi cử; việc xem xét kĩ càng

ex: Both passed the examination successfully.

Institute

(verb). ban hành

ex: These are some of the safety guidelines we’ve instituted in our hotels.

thrive

(verb). Phát triển mạnh

ex: His business thrived in the years before the war.

feasible

(adjective). khả thi

ex: With the extra resources, the project now seems feasible.

propose

(verb). đề nghị

ex: She proposed a boycott of the meeting.

fence

(noun). hàng rào

ex: A cat was walking along the top of the fence.

habitat

(noun). Môi trường sống

ex: wild chimps are in their natural habitat

adapt

(verb). Thích nghi

ex: We had to adapt our plans to fit Jack's timetable.

predator

(noun). Thú săn mồi

ex: The predators were silent, watching their lunch parade by them

establish

(verb). Thiết lập

ex: The brewery was established in 1822.

conservation

(noun). Sự bảo tồn

ex: The conservation policy saved the animals that were at risk

coast

(noun). Bờ biển

ex: Rimini is a thriving resort on the east coast of Italy.

rid

(verb). bỏ đi

ex: In the city, it is hard to rid a building permanently of pests.

collar

(noun). vòng cổ

ex: She tugged at his collar again, but it was useless.

transmit

(verb). truyền tín hiệu

ex: His broadcasts were transmitted late at night.

sections.title: Passage 2: Measures to combat infectious disease in tsarist Russia
sections.html:
Systematic

(adjective). Có hệ thống

ex: We've got to be more systematic in the way that we approach this task.

intelligence

(noun). thông minh

ex: I'm sure a woman with intelligence will shock you

gather

(verb). Thu thập

ex: We gathered blueberries from the bushes.

external

(adjective). phía bên ngoài

ex: the external walls of the house are collapsing

plague

(noun). tai họa

ex: Millions died of (the) plague.

authority

(noun). Người có thẩm quyền

ex: He has no authority over (= ability to control) his students.

implement

(verb). triển khai thực hiện

ex: The country had been slow to implement the new European directive.

empire

(noun). đế chế An extensive group of states or countries ruled over by a single monarch

ex: He was the ruler of the Holy Roman Empire

importation

(noun). sự nhập khẩu

ex: The treaty restricts the importation of cultural artifacts.

infectious

(adjective). truyền nhiễm

ex: After the 21-day isolation period, Ebola survivors are no longer infectious.

disease

(noun). Căn bệnh, dịch bệnh

ex: Thousands die of heart disease each year

outbreak

(noun). bộc phát

ex: Last weekend saw further thundery outbreaks.

court

(noun). tòa án

ex: He's due to appear in court again on Monday.

means

(noun). phương tiện

ex: They had no means of communication.

commercial

(adjective). mang tính thương mại

ex: The capital was the center of the commercial activities.

channel

(noun). kênh

ex: The correct channel has been programmed into it.

merchant

(noun). Thương gia

ex: The merchant was delighted.

military

(adjective). thuộc về quân sự

ex: Military science says that the more troops the greater the strength

personnel

(noun). Nhân sự

ex: Department personnel operated on the basis of out-of-sight, out-of-mind

deploy

(verb). vào hàng ngũ

ex: My job doesn't really allow me fully to deploy my skills/talents.

undercover

(adjective). hoạt động ngầm

ex: he is an undercover detective

agent

(noun). Người đại diện

ex: Please contact our agent in Spain for further information.

Imperial

(adjective). hoàng gia

ex: The entire imperial city knew how taken he was with his mate.

embassy

(noun). đại sứ quán

ex: We used to be friendly with some people who worked at the Swedish Embassy.

customs

(noun). hải quan

ex: we got into trouble with customs officials

epidemic

(noun). Đại dịch

ex: a flu epidemic is happening

respective

(adjective). riêng, từng

ex: They are the respective owners.

ban

(verb). cấm chỉ

ex: She was banned from driving for two years.

suspend

(verb). hoãn, dừng

ex: The ferry service has been suspended for the day because of bad weather.

vessel

(noun). tàu lớn

ex: A warning went out to fishing vessels in the region.

dock

(verb). đưa tàu vào bến\

ex: Hundreds of people turned up to see the ship dock at the pier.

port

(noun). Hải cảng

ex: He advocated the creation of a Hungarian port at Fiume.

credible

(adjective). đáng tin cậy

ex: They haven't produced any credible evidence for convicting him.

existence

(noun). Sự tồn tại

ex: Many people question the existence of God.

depart

(verb). khởi hành

ex: The plane departs at 6 a.m.

undergo

(verb). Trải qua

ex: Playing board games is undergoing a revival in popularity.

quarantine

(noun). Sự cách ly

ex: The horse had to spend several months in quarantine when it reached Britain.

cessation

(noun). sự ngừng

ex: Religious leaders have called for a total cessation of the bombing campaign.

measure

(noun). phép đo lường

ex: They have taken measures to restrict the sale of alcohol

preventative

(adjective). ngăn ngừa

ex: Local knowledge and capacity has proved central to the success of preventative education.

isolation

(noun). sự cô lập

ex: The prisoner had been kept in isolation for three days.

imposition

(noun). sự ban hành luật

ex: Would it be too much of an imposition to ask you to pick my parents up from the airport?

distribution

(noun). Sự phân bố; Phân phối

ex: She was responsible for product distribution

explanatory

(adjective). mang tính giải thích

ex: There are explanatory notes with the diagram.

campaign

(noun). Chiến dịch

ex: The group launched a campaign to protect the area from commercial development

occurrence

(noun). việc xảy ra

ex: Street-fights are an everyday occurrence in this area of the city.

ravage

(noun). phá hoại

ex: They survived the ravages of disease and malnutrition.

dispatch

(verb). gửi, phái đi

ex: Two loads of cloth were dispatched to the factory on 12 December.

besiege

(verb). bủa vây

ex: she was besieged by waiting journalists and fans.

surrender

(verb). đầu hàng

ex: They would rather die than surrender (to the invaders).

chronicle

(noun). Biên niên sử

ex: I heard the sad chronicle of his accidents

capture

(verb). Chụp lấy, bắt lấy

ex: Rebel forces captured the city after a week-long battle.

siege

(noun). sự bao vây

ex: The siege of Mafeking lasted for eight months.

associate

(verb). liên kết

ex: Most people associate this brand with good quality.

suspect

(verb). nghi ngờ

ex: So far, the police do not suspect foul play.

division

(noun). sự phân chia; bộ phận

ex: the equal division of labour between workers

detachment

(noun). biệt đội

ex: A detachment of Italian soldiers was sent to the area.

cordon

(verb). bao vây

ex: the city center was cordoned off after fires were discovered in two stores

boundary

(noun). Ranh giới

ex: The Ural mountains mark the boundary between Europe and Asia.

halt

(verb). Ngăn cản

ex: Filming was halted after the lead actor became ill.

provisional

(adjective). tạm thời

ex: These dates are only provisional.

coherent

(adjective). Mạch lạc

ex: When she calmed down, she was more coherent (= able to speak clearly and be understood).

systematically

(adverb). một cách có hệ thống

ex: They aim to systematically tackle the root causes of the disease.

advent

(noun). Sự xuất hiện/sự ra đời

ex: Life was transformed by the advent of the steam engine.

formulation

(noun). sự tạo thành

ex: Both groups are involved in policy formulation.

publication

(noun). ấn phẩm

ex: The brochure will be ready for publication in September.

attempt

(noun). lần thử, nỗ lực

ex: This would be the only attempt they would make.

procedure

(noun). thủ tục, thể thức

ex: You must follow correct procedure at all times.

proactive

(adjective). Chủ động

ex: Companies are going to have to be more proactive about environmental management.

aftermath

(noun). hậu quả

ex: Many more people died in the aftermath of the explosion.

Senate

(noun). thượng viện

ex: The law has no chance of being passed by the Senate.

monarch

(noun). quốc vương/nữ hoàng

ex: Britain's head of state is a constitutional monarch

decree

(noun). sắc lệnh, chiếu chỉ

ex: More than 200 people were freed by military decree.

subsequent

(adjective). Theo sau

ex: The book discusses his illness and subsequent resignation from politics.

encircle

(verb). bao quanh

ex: The house is encircled by a high fence.

checkpoint

(noun). trạm kiểm soát

ex: When the countdown ends, you sprint off, trying to find the next checkpoint.

duration

(noun). thời lượng

ex: He planned a stay of two years' duration.

operational

(adjective). có tính hệ thống

ex: There are operational advantages in putting sales and admin in the same building.

property

(noun). Tài sản, bất động sản

ex: Children need to be taught to have respect for other people's property.

cattle

(noun). Gia súc

ex: he raises beef/dairy cattle

territory

(noun). Lãnh thổ

ex: He was shot down in enemy territory.

courier

(noun). nhân viên chạy việc vặt; nhân viên chuyển phát nhanh

ex: I want to have this package delivered by motorcycle courier.

Cooperation

(noun). Hợp tác

ex: Without the cooperation of local residents, this movie could not have been made.

Expulsion

(noun). sự trục xuất

ex: They threatened him with expulsion from school.

casualty

(noun). nạn nhân

ex: The rebels suffered heavy casualties.

reactive

(adjective). phản ứng lại, bị động

ex: Unfortunately, the police have dealt with the problem of car theft in a reactive rather than a proactive way.

strategic

(adjective). Mang tính chiến lược

ex: Their bombs are always placed in strategic positions to cause as much chaos as possible.

scale

(noun). Quy mô

ex: This map is large scale (= things are shown in detail).

prompt

(verb). khuyến khích

ex: What prompted you to say that?

provincial

(adjective). tỉnh lẻ

ex: She speaks with a provincial accent

governor

(noun). thống đốc

ex: He mentally appointed a governor, one who would win the hearts of the people

possession

(noun). sự sở hữu

ex: He was found in possession of explosives.

correspondence

(noun). thư từ

ex: Her correspondence with Jim lasted many years.

prior

(adjective). trước đó

ex: The course required no prior knowledge of Spanish.

intuitive

(adjective). thuộc về trực giác

ex: This excludes all possibility of innate ideas or any faculty akin to intuitive reason.

demonstrate

(verb). Trình bày, minh hoạ

ex: These problems demonstrate the importance of strategic planning.

sections.title: Passage 3: Recovering a damaged reputation
sections.html:
misconduct

(noun). hành vi sai trái

ex: The former priest denied allegations of sexual misconduct.

majority

(noun). Đa số

ex: A large majority of people approve of the death sentence.

incompetence

(noun). sự kém cỏi

ex: The events of the last reign had demonstrated the incompetence of the Poles to govern themselves.

eventually

(adverb). Cuối cùng

ex: It might take him ages but he'll do it eventually.

confine

(verb). giới hạn, giam giữ

ex: Please confine your use of the phone to business calls.

individual

(noun). Cá nhân

ex: Every individual has rights which must never be taken away.

perceive

(verb). nhìn nhận, đánh giá

ex: How do the French perceive the British?

wrongdoing

(noun). hành vi sai trái

ex: She has strenuously denied any criminal wrongdoing.

aftermath

(noun). hậu quả

ex: Many more people died in the aftermath of the explosion.

response

(noun). câu trả lời, phản hồi

ex: Her proposals met with an enthusiastic response.

climate

(noun). Khí hậu

ex: The climate is equable and healthy

keep a low profile

(phrase). giữ mình tránh khỏi sự chú ý

ex: He's been in a little trouble recently so he's trying to keep a low profile.

Journalist

(noun). Nhà báo

ex: The journalist took notes throughout the interview.

critic

(noun). nhà phê bình

ex: Her critics say she is leading the party to disaster.

hostile

(adjective). thù địch

ex: The president had a hostile reception in Ohio this morning.

undo

(verb). huỷ bỏ/tháo ra

ex: Can someone help me to undo my seat belt?

regard

(verb). Đánh giá

ex: Her parents always regarded her as the smartest of their children.

extend

(verb). Mở rộng

ex: We have plans to extend our house (= to make it bigger).

editorial

(noun). bài viết của tổng biên tập

ex: All the papers deal with the same subject in their editorials.

suppress

(verb). Đàn áp; Nín, nén, cầm lại; ngăn cản (một cảm xúc..)

ex: The Hungarian uprising in 1956 was suppressed by the Soviet Union.

hypothesis

(noun). Giả thuyết

ex: Several hypotheses for global warming have been suggested.

withhold

(verb). giữ lại

ex: She withheld her rent until the landlord agreed to have the repairs done

manipulate

(verb). thao tác

ex: Throughout her career she has very successfully manipulated the media.

aspect

(noun). Khía cạnh

ex: His illness affects almost every aspect of his life.

peer

(verb). nhìn chăm chú

ex: The driver was peering into the distance trying to read the road sign.

dissent

(noun). sự bất đồng

ex: Rooney was booked for dissent after the referee failed to award United a penalty.

conclude

(verb). Kết luận

ex: Before I conclude, I'd like to thank you all for coming.

misbehavior

(noun). hành vi xấu

ex: The school expelled him for persistent misbehavior.

diminish

(verb). giảm

ex: These memories will not be diminished by time.

credibility

(noun). sự đáng tin cậy

ex: He complained that we had tried to undermine his credibility within the company.

poll

(noun). cuộc thăm dò, khảo sát

ex: The latest opinion poll puts the Democrats in the lead.

proportion

(noun). Tỷ lệ

ex: Children make up a large proportion of the world's population.

professional

(adjective). chuyên nghiệp

ex: Chris, you're a nurse, so can I ask your professional opinion on bandaging ankles?

regain

(verb). lấy lại

ex: She made an effort to regain her self-control.

resign

(verb). từ chức

ex: He resigned from the company in order to take a more challenging job.

junior

(noun). người ít tuổi hơn

ex: She's an office junior

criticism

(noun). chỉ trích

ex: I have a few criticisms to make about your speech.

grace

(noun). Sự duyên dáng

ex: Joanna has natural grace and elegance.

helm

(noun). bánh lái tàu thuyền

ex: Who was at the helm when the collision occurred?

acknowledge

(verb). Công nhận

ex: She acknowledged having been at fault.

press

(noun). báo chí

ex: The incident has been widely reported in the press.

conflict

(noun). Xung đột

ex: There was a lot of conflict between him and his father.

statement

(noun). phát ngôn

ex: He produced a signed statement from the prisoner.

researcher

(noun). Nhà nghiên cứu

ex: She's a researcher on a women's magazine.

challenge

(noun). thử thách

ex: You know me - I like a challenge.

publicity

(noun). sự công khai

ex: We have planned an exciting publicity campaign with our advertisers.

justify

(verb). biện minh

ex: I can't really justify taking another day off work.

dishonest

(adjective). không thành thật

ex: He's been dishonest in his dealings with us/about his past.

engage

(verb). bắt giữ

ex: Just stay out of his way as much as possible, and don't engage with him.

concede

(verb). công nhận

ex: The government has conceded (that) the new tax policy has been a disaster.

unfounded

(adjective). vô căn cứ

ex: Our fears about the weather proved totally unfounded.

argument

(noun). Cuộc tranh luận

ex: He got into an argument with Jeff in the pub last night.

prejudice

(noun). Thành kiến

ex: Laws against racial prejudice must be strictly enforced.

obligation

(noun). Nghĩa vụ

ex: It's her moral obligation to tell the police what she knows.

consequence

(noun). Hậu quả

ex: I told the hairdresser to do what she wanted to my hair, and look at the consequences!

scientific

(adjective). mang tính khoa học

ex:We will have to adopt a more scientific approach in the future.

reference

(noun). Dẫn chứng; Tài liệu tham khảo

ex: He made several references to his time in France.

marathon

(noun). đua đường dài

ex: She did/ran her first marathon in just under three hours.

ongoing

(adjective). tiếp diễn

ex: It was just another episode in an ongoing saga of marriage problems.

sprint

(noun). cuộc đua nước rút

ex: He made a sprint for the finish line.

revelation

(noun). Sự tiết lộ

ex: It's a moment of revelation for her

inaccurate

(adjective). không chính xác

ex: He's using an inaccurate device/weapon

conceal

(verb). che giấu

ex: The listening device was concealed in a pen.

allege

(verb). cáo buộc

ex: She is alleged to have been at the centre of an international drug ring.

relevant

(adjective). Có liên quan

ex: Education should be relevant to the child's needs.

statistics

(noun). Thống kê

ex: The statistics show that, in general, women live longer than men.

publication

(noun). ấn phẩm

ex: The brochure will be ready for publication in September.

expert

(noun). Chuyên gia

ex: My mother is an expert at dress-making (= she does it very well).

strategist

(noun). chiến lược gia

ex: He's the president's chief political strategist.

crisis

(noun). khủng hoảng

ex: The country's leadership is in crisis.

Corporate

(adjective). tập đoàn

ex: The corporate giants try to drive down wages in order to make superprofits

safeguard

(noun). Bảo vệ

ex: The union safeguards the interests of all its members.

confront

(verb). đối mặt

ex: She was confronted by a man wielding a knife.

amongst

(preposition). ở giữa

ex: Relax, you're amongst friends.

controversy

(noun). tranh cãi

ex: The president’s decisions stirred up a lot controversy.

institution

(noun). Tổ chức, viện

ex: I also know a child at the Institution for the Deaf in Mississippi.

IPCC

(noun). Ủy ban Liên chính phủ về Biến đổi Khí hậu

ex: The IPCC was created to provide policymakers with regular scientific assessments on climate change

CRU

(noun). Đơn vị nghiên cứu khí hậu

ex: The aim of the Climatic Research Unit (CRU) is to improve scientific understanding of the climate system

involve

(verb). liên quan, bao gồm

ex: The operation involves putting a small tube into your heart.

subsequent

(adjective). Theo sau

ex: Everything I do makes me better at each subsequent thing. subsequently

inquiry

(noun). điều tra

ex: Who will be leading the inquiry into the accident?

journal

(noun). tập san

ex: She closed the journal and began her preparation.

hunker

(verb). ngồi xổm

ex: We hunkered down near the campfire.

blow

(noun). Tai hoạ, điều gây xúc động mạnh, cú choáng người

ex: Losing his job was a severe blow to his confidence.

plummet

(verb). Thua lỗ mạnh; Lao xuống nhanh

ex: House prices have plummeted in recent months.

Aeronautics

(noun). Hàng không

ex: The aeronautics industry is booming

shuttle

(noun). tàu con thoi

ex: You can take the shuttle across town.

chief

(noun). lãnh đạo

ex: He was the chief ruler of that great city.

executive

(noun). ban quản trị

ex: She is now a senior executive

reverse

(verb). đảo nghịch lại

ex: The Court of Appeal reversed the earlier judgment.

dilemma

(noun). Thế lưỡng nan

ex: We're facing a moral/ethical dilemma

subject

(verb). chinh phục

ex: The invaders quickly subjected the local tribes.

backfire

(verb). phản tác dụng

ex: Her plans to make him jealous backfired on her

interpret

(verb). Diễn giải

ex: The whole play can be interpreted as a lament for lost youth.

collective

(adjective). tập thể

ex: It was Betsy who summed up our collective thoughts.

visible

(adjective). Có thể thấy được

ex: The writing on the tombstone was barely visible.

conduct

(verb). Tiến hành

ex: The experiments were conducted by scientists in New York.

appeal

(verb). thu hút

ex: It's a programme designed to appeal mainly to 16 to 25-year-olds.

integrity

(noun). sự chính trực

ex: No one doubted that the president was a man of the highest integrity.

reluctance

(noun). Sự chần chừ, do dự

ex: I accepted his resignation with great reluctance.

validity

(noun). tính có hiệu lực

ex: Not for one moment did he doubt the validity of those ideas.

transparency

(noun). sự minh bạch

ex: The old-fashioned type of plastic lacked transparency.

scrutiny

(noun). kiểm tra kỹ lưỡng

ex: Will the candidates stand up under all that scrutiny?
